experiments.scope: Rebuilds the accepted connector space of construction C (E_pad + E_0, witness-anchored linearisation, linearised E_1; ranks 1324 -> 1417 -> 1542, DF 58) from the stored witness, beta0, beta1 and alpha1 with the committed linearisation seed, derives the certificate pair from the stored Gray-code index, and per trial checks a fresh seeded point of the space.
experiments.hypothesis: Every point of the rebuilt space gives two 135-byte messages with the fixed padding whose state difference after rounds 0 and 1 is exactly alpha2 (reported as observations), and the pair at the stored index is a full 5-round collision. No cost or probability inference.

experiments.scope: Rebuilds the same connector space and returns 256 distinct pairs of it: the organizer seeds of the request permute the pool of all 506 Stage-1 passes in the index range [0, 2^33) of the committed space, and each trial returns the pair at its assigned pool index, recomputed from the rebuilt space.
experiments.hypothesis: Every returned pair has state difference alpha3 after round 2, so beta4 can be active only in 25 of the 64 rows of plane y = 0 and the 5-round digest XOR is zero on the 156 digest bits of the other 39 rows (probability 1 for such pairs, 2^-156 for pairs that do not follow the trail).
